ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows the sea area near Madagascar in the Southern Hemisphere, marked with the 20°E and 40°E meridians and the latitude of about 20°S; point P is located on the right side of the figure, near 40°E, close to the Madagascar area, and the observation station can be understood as being in the sea area near its western side. Then reason: A tropical storm is a Southern Hemisphere cyclone, and its near-surface airflow rotates clockwise around the center. Wind direction indicates the direction from which the wind blows. The observation station first observed a southeast wind, indicating that the airflow there blew from southeast to northwest. Working backward according to the clockwise circulation, the storm center was roughly on the northeast side of the observation station; afterward, a northeast wind was observed, indicating that the center had moved to the northwest side of the observation station; finally, a northwest wind was observed, indicating that the center was located on the southwest side of the observation station. Therefore, relative to the observation station, the storm center experienced a position change of “northeast side → northwest side → southwest side.” Combined with point P in the figure starting on the eastern side, the path that can make the center first approach from the eastern side and move to the northwest side of the observation station, and then to its southwest side, can be summarized as first moving toward the southwest, then turning toward the southeast.

raw_record.original_question:
据中国天气网讯，热带风暴HARUNA于2013年2月20日8时（北京时间）位于下图中P地，中心附近最大风力达9级。读图回答：

该热带风暴过境时，某观测站观测到的风向变化为“东南→东北→西北”，则该热带风暴的移动路径可能是怎样的？
raw_record.answer: first toward the southwest and then turning toward the southeast
